value.notes: Turn 1: first probe. Checking basic step, dash, pause freeze, esc resume, dash recharge display. Next: test dash recharge countdown, coin/key pickup, lever, spikes, enemy contact, timer, dialogs, buttons.

Suspected score underflow: spikes subtract 500; with score 0 result was 65036 (=65536-500, unsigned wrap). Verifying minimal path: down,down,right,right onto spike (3,3); coin at (1,3) gives 100 first. Next: check clamp behaviour at 100; shorten if possible.

Suspected score underflow: spikes subtract 500 and score wraps to ~65536 instead of clamping at 0. Prior runs: [down down right right] -> score 65136 (coin +100 then spike). Trying a shorter dash version: dash-down (lands (1,3), coin), dash-right (lands on spike (3,3)). If it reproduces, next check: does score 0 alone wrap (no coin), and whether the HUD shows the same wrapped value.

Confirmed one bug: spikes subtract 500 from the score with no clamp at 0, so the score wraps to 65536-400=65136 (unsigned underflow). Seed 42, [down down right right] gave score 65136 after a coin (+100) and a spike hit. Run 1 (score 0 before the spike) gave 65036, which fits the same wrap. The design says the score never goes below 0. My planned dash test was wrong: the first dash set a cooldown of 5, so dash-right was an ordinary step and did not reach the spike. Not yet checked: whether the HUD shows the same wrapped value, and whether a score of 0 alone (no coin) gives 65036 on a minimal run. The 4-token run is believed minimal: removing any token leaves no spike hit or no path to (3,3).

reports.title: Spike damage wraps score below zero to ~65136 instead of clamping at 0
reports.observed: After collecting a coin (score 100) and then stepping on spikes at (3,3), score shows 65136 (65536 - 400), i.e. the subtraction wrapped around. From a score of 0, a spike hit gives 65036.
reports.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so the score should read 0 after the spike hit.
